scope: future H2Oplus scheduler-managed training and development-evaluation synchronization
default_include_classes: scientific result JSON required by the registered local analyzer
host execution and host summary metadata
bounded logs required to establish task completion or diagnose a failure
operational_rules: Do not copy training checkpoints merely to preserve a second local copy.
Keep large artifacts on the execution host when local analysis consumes only result summaries.
Verify the minimal local partition before considering any additional transfer.
A later formal-confirmation deployment must receive separate authorization and build only the artifacts it actually needs.
